question: GQ-004
subject: testing whether the 97.5% overlap was a science-fiction artifact
why: The overlap sample came from science fiction, the Library's STRONGEST subject at 3,291 books. That is the worst case for finding new material, so a single measurement there could not settle the question.
the_pattern: Overlap tracks LIBRARY STRENGTH, not IA content. Where the Library holds thousands, IA offers almost nothing new (93-98% held). Where it holds hundreds, a third of the sample is new. Both corpora draw heavily on Gutenberg, so they converge exactly where Gutenberg is deep.
consequence_for_selection: My subject filter was aimed at the Library's TOP subjects — precisely where it yields least. Aiming at weak subjects inverts it: fewer candidates, higher novelty. Cookery has an IA pool of only 60, so the absolute numbers stay small either way.
honest_ceiling: Across every subject tested the new-book yield is bounded by how much of IA is not Gutenberg-derived. Nothing measured today suggests IA expansion adds thousands of books to this Library; it suggests tens to low hundreds.
